verdict.rationale: Audit logging is a fair axis for an enterprise file-storage service, but the evidence pack never mentions team or tenant audit or event logs, an audit-log API, or SIEM export. Delta query, change notifications and file version history are adjacent change-tracking features for application developers, not documented audit trails of user activity, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, activity is auditable — team event/audit logs with documented API access or SIEM export
